content.text:
The site's custom font wasn't loading, so every page was falling back to the default system font. That's why all six pages looked different at once.

**Cause:** `site/css/tokens.css` loads the font from `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the file is in `site/fonts/` (with an "s"). The request got a 404 on every page. The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see in git which edit introduced it.

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. That one line is the whole change.

**Checks:**
- I loaded all six pages in a headless browser. The font now loads on each one, with no failed requests or console errors.
- I checked every other stylesheet, image and script reference on the site, and they all point to files that exist.
- The functional tests pass (16 of 16).

I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
